name: Bernd und das rätsel um unteralterbach:2
source:
Thirteen years have passed since the events of the first game. What was once a world full of hope has fallen into darkness. Powerful and ruthless individuals have taken control of governments, cities, and entire nations, spreading fear and corruption across the globe. Freedom has become a distant memory, and most people have lost hope for a better future.

As the world continues to crumble, a new threat emerges, one capable of destroying what little remains of civilization. The choices made in the past have shaped the present, and now the fate of humanity rests in the hands of a new generation.

[From [url=https://roswitz.itch.io/bernd-und-das-ratsel-um-unteralterbach2]Itch.io[/url]]
